groups.title: Chat or Code?
items: Chat is for words: questions, drafts, reading a paper you drop in. The answer stays in the chat.
Code is for making things. Claude works in a folder on your laptop: it makes files, runs them and fixes what breaks.
Want words back? Chat. Want a thing made? Code.

groups.title: Getting good results
items: Talk to it like a smart assistant. Say what it's for and who will use it.
Give it your stuff: your CV, a paper, a spreadsheet.
Start small, then ask for changes. "Make it simpler." "Add a page for my book."
When something looks wrong, say what you see, or paste the error.
In Code, it asks before doing things on your laptop. Read it, then say yes.
Pick Opus 5.5. The Stanford account doesn't include the Fable models.
One project per thing you build. Rename it and pin it, so you find it tomorrow.
